steps.name: Compile and execute exact pool worker identity controls
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for suite in executor_lifecycle_native executor_worker_native executor_control_native executor_root_native; do
  timeout 60s rustc --edition=2024 --test "sdk/rust-standard-runtime/tests/$suite.rs" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/$suite"
done
python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP" <<'PY'
import pathlib, re, subprocess, sys
root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
expected = {'executor_lifecycle_native': ['actual_worker_start_and_complete_provision_are_required_before_acceptance', 'closing_worker_tls_submission_requires_actual_successor_and_old_close_cannot_kill_it', 'fallible_admission_reservation_pins_worker_without_accepting_or_losing_work', 'finite_close_round_limit_refuses_before_an_unclosable_successor_or_future_is_accepted', 'independent_pool_state_and_empty_queue_do_not_confuse_unfinished_future', 'logical_empty_still_waits_for_real_wake_drop_tls_and_frame_boundaries', 'partially_started_generation_retains_started_worker_until_its_real_exit', 'successor_reuses_index_only_after_old_worker_tls_drains_without_retiring_its_record', 'wake_requeue_is_reserved_before_admission_and_late_generation_never_recreates_task'], 'executor_worker_native': ['recycled_canonical_index_retains_distinct_worker_keys_and_arc_leases', 'worker_lease_frame_callback_keeps_each_real_child_identity_after_return_to_root', 'worker_lease_refuses_root_ready_foreign_context_stale_executor_and_duplicate_transfer', 'worker_lease_retains_actual_arc_until_separate_tls_and_frame_notifications'], 'executor_control_native': ['actual_bridge_carries_worker_keys_through_recycled_canonical_index_and_arc_release', 'old_and_new_worker_callbacks_are_keyed_to_their_own_generations', 'three_reused_generations_retire_only_their_exact_worker_keys'], 'executor_root_native': ['captured_pool_and_control_retire_before_executor_completion_notification', 'last_executor_retirement_notifies_the_second_drain_check', 'pending_executor_keeps_its_owner_and_does_not_invent_a_notification', 'release_callback_successor_requires_a_fresh_scan_and_keeps_its_owner', 'retirement_invalidates_a_previously_quiescent_stamp']}
for suite, cases in expected.items():
    listing = subprocess.run([str(root / suite), "--list"], capture_output=True, timeout=60, check=True)
    assert len(listing.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(listing.stderr) <= 1024 * 1024
    observed = [line.removesuffix(": test") for line in listing.stdout.decode().splitlines() if line.endswith(": test")]
    assert len(observed) == len(set(observed)) == len(cases) and set(observed) == set(cases), suite
    result = subprocess.run([str(root / suite), "--test-threads=1"], capture_output=True, timeout=60, check=True)
    assert len(result.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(result.stderr) <= 1024 * 1024
    passed = re.findall(rb"^test ([^\r\n]+) \.\.\. ok$", result.stdout, re.M)
    assert len(passed) == len(cases) and {name.decode() for name in passed} == set(cases), suite
    assert f"test result: ok. {len(cases)} passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;".encode() in result.stdout, suite
    print(result.stdout.decode(), end="")
PY

steps.name: Execute reused-index mutex and rwlock controls
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP" <<'PY'
import hashlib
import pathlib
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
base = pathlib.Path("sdk/rust-standard-runtime")
files = ("mutex.rs", "rwlock.rs", "condvar.rs", "parker.rs", "once.rs",
         "thread_wait.rs", "tests/thread_sync_native.rs", "tests/mutex_reuse_cases.rs.inc")
before = {}
for name in files:
    path = root / base / name
    assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), name
    value = path.read_bytes()
    assert len(value) <= 65536 and b"\r" not in value, name
    before[name] = value
source = before["tests/thread_sync_native.rs"]
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest() == "db61a651ef33931b90d6c2af44abee352936a1cf3a059c637bef13c14dcef67a"
added = before["tests/mutex_reuse_cases.rs.inc"]
original_cases = re.findall(rb"(?m)^#\[test\]\nfn ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\(", source)
new_cases = re.findall(rb"(?m)^#\[test\]\nfn ([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\(", added)
expected_new = [b"reused_index_after_leaked_mutex_guard_waits_without_fabricating_ownership",
                b"reused_index_after_leaked_writer_guard_keeps_rwlock_gate_closed",
                b"reference_safe_forgotten_guards_keep_locks_held_after_thread_exit"]
assert len(original_cases) == len(set(original_cases)) == 22
assert new_cases == expected_new
current = before["mutex.rs"]
comment = b"""        // A canonical index may be reused after an earlier thread leaked its
        // guard. A matching number alone cannot establish recursive ownership.
        // Waiting also preserves the allowed deadlock behavior for true recursion.
"""
old_guard = b'        assert_ne!(self.owner.get(), Some(current), "recursive logical mutex lock");\n'
assert current.count(comment) == 1 and old_guard not in current
old = current.replace(comment, old_guard)
assert hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest() == "f644c9d6356c12e9467354267b34fd66353dd9c659b812b849a391545c690090"

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rust-mutex-reuse-", dir=sys.argv[1]) as temporary:
    temporary = pathlib.Path(temporary)
    executables = {}
    for variant in ("old", "current"):
        target = temporary / variant / base
        for name in files[:-1]:
            value = old if variant == "old" and name == "mutex.rs" else before[name]
            if name == "tests/thread_sync_native.rs":
                value += added
            path = target / name
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(value)
        executable = temporary / variant / "sync-controls"
        command = ["rustc", "--edition=2024", "--test", str(target / "tests/thread_sync_native.rs"), "-o", str(executable)]
        compiled = subprocess.run(command, cwd=temporary, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
        assert len(compiled.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(compiled.stderr) <= 1024 * 1024
        if compiled.returncode:
            print(compiled.stderr.decode(errors="replace"), file=sys.stderr)
            raise AssertionError("sync source-control compilation failed: " + variant)
        executables[variant] = executable
    for case in expected_new[:2]:
        result = subprocess.run([str(executables["old"]), "--exact", case.decode(), "--nocapture"],
                                cwd=temporary, capture_output=True, timeout=20)
        assert len(result.stdout) + len(result.stderr) <= 1024 * 1024
        combined = result.stdout + result.stderr
        assert result.returncode != 0 and b"recursive logical mutex lock" in combined
        assert b"must reach the real" in combined and b"FAILED" in combined
    listing = subprocess.run([str(executables["current"]), "--list"], cwd=temporary,
                             capture_output=True, timeout=20, check=True)
    assert len(listing.stdout) + len(listing.stderr) <= 1024 * 1024
    actual = [line.removesuffix(b": test") for line in listing.stdout.splitlines() if line.endswith(b": test")]
    expected = original_cases + expected_new
    assert len(actual) == len(set(actual)) == len(expected) == 25 and set(actual) == set(expected)
    result = subprocess.run([str(executables["current"]), "--test-threads=1"], cwd=temporary,
                            capture_output=True, timeout=60, check=True)
    assert len(result.stdout) + len(result.stderr) <= 1024 * 1024
    passed = re.findall(rb"(?m)^test ([^\r\n]+) \.\.\. ok$", result.stdout)
    assert len(passed) == 25 and set(passed) == set(expected)
    assert b"test result: ok. 25 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;" in result.stdout
    guard = temporary / "guard_send.rs"
    guard.write_text("fn require_send<T: Send>() {}\nfn main() { require_send::<std::sync::MutexGuard<'static, ()>>(); require_send::<std::sync::RwLockWriteGuard<'static, ()>>(); }\n")
    denied = subprocess.run(["rustc", "--edition=2024", str(guard), "-o", str(temporary / "guard")],
                            cwd=temporary, capture_output=True, timeout=20)
    assert denied.returncode != 0 and len(denied.stderr) <= 1024 * 1024
    assert denied.stderr.count(b"cannot be sent between threads safely") >= 2
    assert b"MutexGuard" in denied.stderr and b"RwLockWriteGuard" in denied.stderr
    print("two old reused-index failures; 25 source-port controls passed; MutexGuard and RwLockWriteGuard are !Send")
for name in files:
    assert (root / base / name).read_bytes() == before[name], name
PY
